summary: Comprehensive testing of Dice Rush MVP completed. Backend API tests: 27/27 passed (100%). Frontend UI tests: All core features working correctly. Game flow, dice selection, scoring validation, and turn switching all functional. Fixed WinnerModal bug (hardcoded threshold).

integration_issues.issue: Frontend game logic is fully client-side. Backend has REST API endpoints (/api/validate-score, /api/check-scoring, /api/games/save) but frontend doesn't use them for game logic. Game works correctly but backend APIs are unused.

action_items: Consider integrating backend score validation API if server-side validation is needed in future
Backend APIs for game history, stats, and leaderboard are available but not used by frontend
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: WinnerModal was hardcoding '3000 points' instead of using WIN_THRESHOLDS[winMode]. Updated to dynamically show correct threshold.
All React Native best practices followed: Text components, StyleSheet.create(), testID attributes present
Scoring logic duplicated in frontend (gameLogic.ts) and backend (server.py) - both implementations match
MongoDB ObjectId properly excluded in backend queries
seed_data_creation: Test data created: TEST_pytest_client status checks, TEST_Player1 and TEST_Player2 game history and stats
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core game features tested and working. Backend API is functional but not integrated with frontend game logic. Frontend uses client-side Zustand store for all game state. WinnerModal bug fixed to show correct win threshold.
